name: workbar
description: Shows how far along Claude is and when it will really be done, what it is waiting on, and when a chat is getting too big or going cold. Small, close to zero tokens, terminal and desktop app.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto: while Claude works the band always shows the plan, or why there is none; between tasks it shows only when there is something to see or do (agents, files changed, a warning), and the chat size lives in the status line. always: also show the chat-size gauge between tasks and in a new chat. off: status line only.

progressTool.title: Ask Claude for a progress plan
progressTool.description: On: Claude reports steps and an estimate through a tiny tool (about 150 cached tokens per request, a few dozen per task), a message that runs past 3 tool calls with no plan gets one ~35-token reminder, and a plan that falls behind the work gets a ~30-token reminder to report (at most 3 per message). Off: no tokens at all; the bar then follows Claude’s own todo or task list when it keeps one.

holdMessages.title: Hold a message into an oversized or cold chat
holdMessages.description: Before a message goes into a very large chat, or a large one whose prompt cache has expired, hold it once and offer Compact or Hand off. Pressing Enter again sends it anyway.

topicCheck.title: Spot a new task in a long chat
topicCheck.description: In chats over 60k tokens, notice when a new message looks like a different task and suggest a fresh chat. A free local word check runs first; only a message that shares almost no words with your recent ones is sent to Haiku as a ~150-token note (never the chat). Off: no model calls at all.

warnTokens.title: Chat size: warn at
warnTokens.description: Tokens at which the band turns amber and suggests finishing this task here. At twice this it turns red and recommends Compact or Hand off.

notify.title: Desktop alerts
notify.description: A pop-up when Claude needs your approval, has waited 15 s on a question, or finishes a run of 2 minutes or more. Uses Claude Code's own notifications (the desktop app, terminals that have them); on Windows Terminal a Windows toast.

activityDir.title: Activity marker folder
activityDir.description: Optional. A folder where each session writes a <session>.txt file reading 'busy <ms>' or 'idle <ms>', for your own scripts (for example: sleep the machine once Claude is done). Empty: off.
